maera.name: Maera
maera.title: Hearth Tutor
maera.greet: The Hollow remembers names. Yours will do. Sit. The fire has opinions.
lines: Welcome to Emberfen Hollow. This dusk does not end. The First Fire is the only clock we trust.
Left-click the ground to walk. The path finds itself. If it doesn't, the water ate a tile. Don't follow it.
East: emberwood and moonbloom. Click a tree or a pale flower and wait. Foraging is a conversation, not a theft.
South: ash, wolves, and a ruined circle of imps. Click a beast to fight. They remember who struck first.
I for your pack. Enter to speak. Click another wanderer to trade. Lock, then both accept. The Hollow hates thieves.
Voss sells what the dusk refuses to give freely. His vault is honest. His prices are not kind, but they are fair.
South of the hearth, the Binding Shrine. Stand on the purple stone and Bind. Bread, salve, blades. The shrine eats what you feed it.
I was here when the fire was a coal. I will be here when you are a story. Learn the Hollow before it learns you.
If you fall, you wake beside this fire. Coin may slip from your fingers. Pride usually does too.
The Stag is not a trophy. It is a question the forest asks. Answer carefully.

voss.name: Voss
voss.title: Keeper of Coin
voss.greet: Coin, vault, or both. Don't bleed on the counter. I just oiled it.
lines: I keep the stall and the vault. Buy from the list. Shift-click your pack to bank. Click the vault to take it back.
Ember coins are stamped with a closed eye. Spend them like the eye is watching. It is.
Ashblades go to people who come back. If you want one, prove you can carry bread first.
I don't haggle. The dusk already took its cut. Mine is smaller.
Maera thinks I'm soft. Nima thinks I'm a vulture. Both are half right. Pay or walk.
If you die south of here, don't come crying about lost fangs. The ash keeps what it likes.

nima.name: Nima
nima.title: Dock Watcher
nima.greet: West water never freezes. Don't ask why. The imps drink it. So did I, once.
lines: I count ripples. When they run the wrong way, something in the ash is hunting upward.
Wolves hold the southern ash. They are not evil. They are hungry in a place that forgot seasons.
Imps nest in the cracked circle. They throw cinders. Keep a bow if your pride is brittle.
If you hear a bell that isn't there, that's the Hollow Stag. Rare. Proud. It walks the eastern copse at the hour with no name.
Trade with the living. The dead keep what they drop, except when they don't. Then Voss gets involved.
Maera taught me to walk. Voss taught me to count. The water taught me to wait. I'm still waiting.
Don't swim. The Hollow doesn't do drowning. It does keeping.

brin.name: Brin
brin.title: Ash Hunter
brin.greet: If you're heading south, take bread. Wolves don't wait for speeches.
lines: I lost a sister to the circle. Not to the imps. To the idea that she could talk them down.
Gloom wolves telegraph the lunge. Sidestep. Then punish. Combat is a rhythm, not a prayer.
The Stag only aggroes if you look at it like meat. Look at it like weather and you might live.
Fang and hide go to the shrine. Binding a vest from a thing that tried to eat you is the Hollow's sense of humor.
If you see me running, don't ask where. Follow or don't. Standing still is how the ash writes names.

selva.name: Selva
selva.title: Shrine Binder
selva.greet: The shrine is hungry, not holy. Feed it honestly.
lines: Stand on the binding stone. Open Bind. The recipe list is a promise: inputs in, work out.
Moonbloom and emberwood make hearthbread. That's the first kindness. Salve is the second. Blades are a later conversation.
If Binding fails, you weren't close enough, or the dusk decided you were greedy. Usually the first.
I don't sell faith. I sell sequence. Respect the sequence and the shrine respects you.
Maera says the fire remembers. I say the shrine forgets on purpose. That's why we write recipes down.

kesh.name: Kesh
kesh.title: Wounded Wanderer
kesh.greet: I made it back. That's the whole story. The rest is bruising.
lines: There were two of us. There is one of me. Don't look for the other name. The ash already has it.
Click a wolf, don't let it click you. If your health sings, eat bread. Pride is a terrible bandage.
I tried to trade with a corpse. Voss charged me for the lesson. Fair.
If you're kind, sit. If you're useful, go south and come back louder than you left.
The Hollow isn't cruel. It's exact. That's worse, and better.

oren.name: Oren
oren.title: Night Watch
oren.greet: I don't sleep. The dusk doesn't either. We have an arrangement.
lines: North of the hearths is quiet. Quiet is a lie with good manners.
If two wanderers stand close and lock a trade, I look away. That's the closest we get to privacy.
Chat local if your secrets are small. Global if you want Maera to sigh.
I saw the Stag drink from the west water. It didn't ripple. That's when I stopped asking the dock questions.
Stay. Or go. The watch doesn't keep people. It keeps the fire from being lonely.

tavi.name: Tavi
tavi.title: Scavenger
tavi.greet: Don't sprint. Don't shout. Don't loot a corpse while it's still deciding.
lines: Zomboid rule one: the bite is a schedule, not a surprise. Dusk walkers telegraph with the jaw. Sidestep, then the crowbar.
Ash dens hold fangs and hide. Mine crawlers hold ichor. Road thugs hold coin and bad ideas. Pick your hunger.
I stash nails in a bat because a pretty edge chips. Ugly lasts. That's the Hollow's whole thesis.
If you hear dragging, it's walkers. If you hear laughing, it's thugs. If you hear nothing, you already missed the hound.
Maera teaches names. I teach not dying. Both are religions. Mine has fewer hymns.
East copse is food. South ash is a test. The mine is a dare. Johns Lake strip is where GTA brains come to get paid or get cut.
Never fight two walkers in a doorway. Never fight a thug on a road. Never fight a hound while you're eating. That's the whole combat manual.
Bring bread. Bring a friend. Bring the willingness to drop the bag and run. Pride is how the ash writes obituaries.

rook.name: Rook
rook.title: Fence
rook.greet: Heat's a weather. I sell umbrellas. Don't tell Voss I said that.
lines: Voss is legal. I'm adjacent. Difference is I know which thug dropped which wrap, and I don't put it on a receipt.
GTA rule: you don't own the strip. The strip owns the minute you look rich. Keep coin in the vault. Flex in the ash, not on Hwy 50.
Road thugs travel in opinions. Isolate one. The second always has a friend. The third has a story for Mira.
If you want a nail bat, bind it or take it off a man who thought the road was his. I don't ask which.
Want work? Walkers south of the plaza. Thugs on the Johns Lake strip. Hounds by the cinder circle. Crawlers in Agate. That's a night.
I don't do portraits. I do consequences. Bot girl's people do the other kind of heat. Mine bruises.
Trade with the living. The dead don't haggle, they just drop. That's the cleanest deal in Clermont.

lila.name: Lila
lila.title: Field Medic
lila.greet: Sit. Scrubs rolled, sandals off. I'm Lila — I still make house calls to the square.
lines: Cinder salve for holes. Hearthbread for the shake after. Moontea if your hands forget they have bones.
Walkers don't sprint until they do. If you get grabbed, you are already late. Crowbar to the knee, then the jaw, then you come to me.
I keep extra wraps by the hearth. Not because I'm kind. Because corpses are terrible patients.
South ash eats cocky melee. Take a bow if your pride can stand not being seen.
If Yara sent you, you're bleeding on purpose. If Tavi sent you, you're bleeding by accident. Both pay in stories.
The Hollow likes girls who come back. Come back.
Don't kiss a wound. That's a visual novel, and this is a shift. Bind it, eat, go again.

yara.name: Yara
yara.title: Pit Tutor
yara.greet: Click a thing that wants you dead. That's combat. Everything else is flavor.
lines: Left click a mob: you swing. Gloom wolves lunge on a count of two. Imps spit. Walkers grab. Thugs feint. Hounds don't feint.
Range is a religion. Dirk is 1.4. Ashblade a hair more. Thornbow is how adults live. Crowbar is how adults live in doorways.
Combat XP is on hit and on kill. Don't pad on raccoons once you can take a walker. The Hollow notices when you farm cowardice.
Leash: walkers forget at 10 tiles, thugs at 12, the Stag never really forgets. Don't kite into a second pack. That's how duos become stories.
If your HP sings, bread. If it screams, salve. If it stops, you wake at the First Fire minus coin and whatever pride you packed.
Brin hunts ash. I hunt habits. Break the habit of standing still. Standing still is how the dusk signs your name.
Want a real night? Walker, thug, hound, crawler, then the Stag if you still have a face. That's the combat ladder. Climb or don't.

rita.name: Rita
rita.title: Pump-Side Mechanic
rita.greet: Pumps are dry but the lot still smells like summer. Check the bay if you need a tire iron.
lines: Hancock pumps. The tanks are a rumor. The canisters on the pad are not.
Maple and Oak still have kitchens. Walk in the south door. Cabinets remember canned peaches better than people.
Walkers like the streets. Don't fight two in a doorway. Crowbar, then the lot, then me if you're leaking.
Willow Park is the only green that isn't trying to eat you. Berries, mint, the occasional raccoon with opinions.
If you find a pump key, it's mine. I'll still let you keep it. The pumps don't listen to either of us.
Gas cans, wrenches, a flashlight if the bay is kind. Don't sleep in the wrecks. The upholstery has teeth.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.title: Shake Row
rosa.greet: Hey — easy, the cherries roll. Crate hip, flip-flops, cherry toes. You buying, flirting, or lost?
lines: Mama Mira's neon is behind me. Cool Down if you're dying. I'm the crate girl. Don't make me chase a cherry down Hwy 50.
Flip-flops stay on until I say they don't. Heat like this, I don't pretend otherwise.
Selva binds. I carry. Different religions. Mine has better ankles.

michelle.name: Michelle
michelle.title: Mommy
michelle.greet: Alec, I just got off the plane, can you not stare at my tits for five seconds?

motel_clerk.name: June
motel_clerk.title: Palm Court Clerk
motel_clerk.greet: Palm Court. Cash first, AC second. Ice machine's a rumor after 10.
lines: Rooms face the lot. Don't leave valuables in a Civic with Florida plates.
If you hear arguing upstairs, it's the AC and a couple who forgot they booked a queen.
Michelle's on Sanctuary. Don't ask me for her number. Ask the neon.

barista.name: Sloane
barista.title: Green Siren Barista
barista.greet: Iced anything, neon hours. Name for the cup — or just take it and run.
lines: Hwy 50 order: oat, no foam, look like you slept. I can fake two of those.
Mira's Cool Down is dessert. This is fuel. Different religions.
If Amanda texts you about a latte, tell her the kiosk remembers.

pharmacist.name: Priya
pharmacist.title: Clermont Rx
pharmacist.greet: Scripts, sunscreen, and the kind of quiet that sells better than candy.
lines: Heat rash aisle is left. Actual heat is outside. Pick one.
Lila sends people here when salve isn't enough. Listen to Lila.
We close when the lot rats start leaning on the glass.

neighbor.name: Carol
neighbor.title: Sanctuary Neighbor
neighbor.greet: Sanctuary Drive. Keep the music down after nine — Michelle already owns the block.
lines: That teal roof? Hers. Don't park in the swamp strip.
If you see Amanda's car, wave. If you don't, mind your own driveway.
HOA is a Facebook group and a prayer. Welcome to Clermont.

lot_attendant.name: Dex
lot_attendant.title: Lot Attendant
lot_attendant.greet: Lot's free until it isn't. Don't sleep in the wrecks. Don't tip me in heat.
lines: Traffic loops Hwy 50 like it owes rent. Parked cars are quieter company.
Gage is east if you want a pistol. Mira is neon if you want a Cool Down.
Cleanup duty pays in gold and fewer rats. Your call.

amanda_friend.name: Tessa
amanda_friend.title: Amanda's Friend
amanda_friend.greet: Amanda said you'd show. I'm Tessa — don't make Michelle explain me.
lines: Amanda's adjacent to this story, not the door. Michelle owns the door.
Kiosk coffee, then Sanctuary. That's the polite loop.
If Bot girl deepens this later, remember I was kind first.

club27_host.name: Nova
club27_host.title: Club 27 hostess
club27_host.greet: Cover's twenty. Or make me smile and we'll call it a tip.
lines: Club 27 Cabaret — 215 US-27. Neon, smoke, and girls who know the tip jar.
Hwy 50 brings the thirsty. US-27 brings the bold.
You look like Sanctuary Drive money. Don't waste it on the first dancer.
Quiet Spa is west if you need to cool off after the bass.

quiet_spa_tech.name: Sori
quiet_spa_tech.title: Quiet Spa tech
quiet_spa_tech.greet: Shoes off. Phone on silent. We don't do Hwy 50 volume in here.
lines: Quiet Spa on Hwy 50 west — oils, steam, and nobody yelling about Blizzards.
French tips stay pretty if you don't rush the soak.
Citrus Tower's north if you want a view after you unclench.
Ask Nova at Club 27 if you're here for heat instead of calm.

citrus_guide.name: Tessa
citrus_guide.title: Citrus Tower guide
citrus_guide.greet: Elevator's slow. View's worth it. Don't lean on the rail like a tourist.
lines: Citrus Tower — Clermont's big stick on the skyline.
On a clear day you can pretend Horizon West is romantic.
Waterfront Park is south if your legs want grass instead of stairs.
Shakes on Hwy 50 when the height makes you dizzy.

park_ranger.name: Jules
park_ranger.title: Waterfront ranger
park_ranger.greet: Keep the path. Alligators don't care about your Tesla.
lines: Waterfront Park — loop the boardwalk, don't feed anything with teeth.
Sunset hits different off the lake. Phone pics are free.
Club 27 is loud. Here is not. Pick a mood.
If you came from Sanctuary Drive, wave at Michelle for me — first name only.

horizon_realtor.name: Kira
horizon_realtor.title: Horizon West flier
horizon_realtor.greet: Model homes, model wives, model lies. You looking or browsing?
lines: Horizon West billboards never sleep. Neither do the HOA texts.
Kissimmee tourists get lost past 27. Clermont locals don't.
If you're house-hunting with Mommy energy, Sanctuary Drive already has drama.

kissimmee_driver.name: Dez
kissimmee_driver.title: Kissimmee shuttle
kissimmee_driver.greet: Disney traffic is a lifestyle. Tip if you want AC that works.
lines: Kissimmee to Clermont is twenty minutes or two hours. Florida decides.
I don't ask what's in the trunk. You don't ask what's in my cooler.
Hwy 50 shakes hit different after a tourist day.
